name: komdosh-dev-infra-iac
description: Terraform and OpenTofu authoring, plan-safety analysis, and state discipline — with the Yandex Cloud resource layer built in. Ships iac-author (module structure, pinned providers, for_each over count by stable key, remote encrypted state, prevent_destroy on stateful resources; on YC: VPC with per-zone subnets and default-deny security groups, Managed K8s with regional HA masters, Managed PostgreSQL/Kafka/Redis with HA + backups, Lockbox + KMS, Container Registry, least-privilege IAM) and the read-only iac-reviewer (correctness · state safety · security · cost · drift; on YC: IAM over-grants, SA-key exposure, network exposure, managed-DB HA, zonal masters in prod, Audit Trails, and PII residency under 152-FZ and GDPR). Four skills: discover-terraform-layout, verify-plan-safety (classifies every create/update/replace/destroy and flags forces-replacement before apply), discover-yc-context, verify-yc-resources. Seven rules: terraform-style, terraform-state-safety, terraform-plan-review, yc-terraform, yc-security, yc-managed-services, yc-data-residency. Six commands: /tf-module, /tf-plan-review, /tf-audit, /yc-provision, /yc-audit, /yc-context. Uses the Terraform registry MCP for current versions. Never runs apply or destroy. Requires komdosh-dev-infra-core.
